_note: Source for the Donna.AI demo line on Retell: ONE agent (sales + multi-industry demo in one prompt, prompts/demo_line.txt). `python3 retell_push.py build` writes the import-ready request bodies to retell/. ${NAME} placeholders are filled from environment variables by `retell_push.py push`; nothing secret is stored here. Cal.com booking tools are added in the Retell dashboard (connection-based integration), not here.

llm.begin_message: Donna speaking — Donna.AI. Quick heads-up: I'm an AI, and this call is recorded. So you want to know what I'm about. Smart move. Tell me — what kind of business do you run?

general_tools.name: end_call
general_tools.description: End the call after the wrap-up, or when the caller says goodbye.

general_tools.name: transfer_to_founder
general_tools.description: Transfer to the founder, only when the caller asks for a person and agrees to be transferred.

post_call_analysis_data.name: business_name
post_call_analysis_data.description: The caller's own business name, if given.

post_call_analysis_data.name: business_type
post_call_analysis_data.description: The caller's kind of business (for example: plumbing, med spa, dental, law firm, auto repair, real estate, cleaning).

post_call_analysis_data.name: callback_number
post_call_analysis_data.description: The callback number the caller confirmed, in E.164 format (+1XXXXXXXXXX). Empty if not confirmed.

post_call_analysis_data.name: avg_job_value
post_call_analysis_data.description: What the caller said one customer or job is worth, in their words. Empty if not said.

post_call_analysis_data.name: demo_company
post_call_analysis_data.description: The made-up demo company Donna played (for example: Northbeam Home Services, Willow & Ash Studio). Empty if no demo was played.

post_call_analysis_data.name: demo_booked
post_call_analysis_data.description: True if a demo appointment was booked or demo-booked inside the demo.

post_call_analysis_data.name: demo_appointment_time
post_call_analysis_data.description: The demo booking's day and time in plain words. Empty if none.

post_call_analysis_data.name: booked
post_call_analysis_data.description: True if a real call with the founder or a free audit was booked on this call.

post_call_analysis_data.name: appointment_time
post_call_analysis_data.description: The founder call or audit day and time in plain words. Empty if none.

post_call_analysis_data.name: sms_ok
post_call_analysis_data.description: True only if the caller clearly said yes to receiving a text message.

post_call_analysis_data.name: urgent
post_call_analysis_data.description: True if the caller asked the founder to call back today, or reported a real emergency.

post_call_analysis_data.name: lead_temperature
post_call_analysis_data.description: Hot: wants to book or start. Warm: interested, not ready. Cold: not interested or not a business owner.
